relationships.relation_statement: On the full-degree squarefree Wronskian locus in Gr(k,C[z]_{<n}), write the k(n-k) distinct roots as t_i. The fibre is the intersection of k(n-k) one-box Schubert divisors for the osculating flags at t_i. Thus generic inverse Wronski problems are the all-one-box osculating Schubert subfamily.
relationships.evidence_location: Abstract: equivalence of a prescribed Wronskian with incidence against osculating planes; apply one simple-root condition at each root.
relationships.inheritance_policy: No automatic inheritance. Apply only results whose Schubert data consist of k(n-k) one-box conditions and whose root and characteristic hypotheses agree.
relationships.caveats: This statement is scoped to squarefree full-degree Wronskians. Repeated roots lead to unions of higher-partition Schubert strata with multiplicities, not one fixed arbitrary partition. Ordering the roots introduces a base change and must not be silently used to identify monodromy groups.
